fields.title: DGCP procurement process record
fields.description: One record per Dominican Republic DGCP procurement process, produced by mode=list (a filtered page of /procesos results, optionally enriched with full detail) or mode=detail (one specific process code's full detail: contracts, offers received, requested line items). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a record can't be fetched.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: For list records: 'list:<filters applied>'. For detail records: the process code that was requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which strategy emitted this record (S1-api-procesos, S1-api-procesos+contratos+ofertas+articulos, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed records (blocked_or_transient, not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_detailError.title: Detail enrichment error
_detailError.description: Present only on a list-mode row when fetchDetail=true and that row's own detail fetch failed -- the rest of the row's list fields are still valid.

codigo_proceso.title: Process code
codigo_proceso.description: DGCP's stable identifier for this procurement process, e.g. 'SUPERATE-CCC-CP-2026-0012'.

codigo_unidad_compra.title: Buyer unit code
codigo_unidad_compra.description: Internal DGCP code for the purchasing government institution.

unidad_compra.title: Buyer unit name
unidad_compra.description: The purchasing government institution's name, e.g. 'Direccion de Desarrollo Social Superate'.

modalidad.title: Procurement modality
modalidad.description: e.g. 'Comparacion de Precios', 'Licitacion Publica Nacional', 'Procesos de Excepcion'.

tipo_excepcion.title: Exception type
tipo_excepcion.description: Sub-type for 'Procesos de Excepcion' modality processes (e.g. 'Publicidad'); 'Proceso ordinario' for normal processes.

descripcion.title: Description
descripcion.description: The process's free-text description, as published.

estado_proceso.title: Process status
estado_proceso.description: e.g. 'Proceso publicado' (open for bids), 'Proceso adjudicado y celebrado' (awarded), 'Proceso desierto' (no bids), 'Cancelado'.

divisa.title: Currency
divisa.description: Currency code for monto_estimado, typically DOP (Dominican peso).

fecha_apertura_ofertas2.title: Second bid opening date (technical/economic envelopes, when applicable)

dirigido_mipymes.title: Targeted at MSMEs
dirigido_mipymes.description: 'Si'/'No' -- whether this process is reserved for MSMEs (micro/small/medium enterprises).

es_snip.title: Is SNIP project
es_snip.description: 'Si'/'No' -- linked to the National Public Investment System (Sistema Nacional de Inversion Publica).

numero_proveedores_notificados.title: Suppliers notified
numero_proveedores_notificados.description: How many registered suppliers were auto-notified of this process.

url.title: Public listing URL
url.description: Link to this process on the Comprasdominicana transactional portal (comunidad.comprasdominicana.gob.do), verbatim.

adquisicion_planeada.title: Planned acquisition
adquisicion_planeada.description: 'Si'/'No' -- whether this was in the buyer's Annual Procurement Plan (PACC).

justificacion_no_pacc.title: Justification
justificacion_no_pacc.description: Free text -- justification for the acquisition, or for its absence from the PACC.

organismo_financiero_externo.title: External financing body
organismo_financiero_externo.description: 'Si'/'No' -- financed via an external body (e.g. World Bank, IDB).

contratos.title: Contracts (detail records only)
contratos.description: Every contract awarded under this process, verbatim from DGCP's /contratos endpoint -- includes winning supplier (razon_social/rpe), contracted value (valor_contratado), status, and payment terms. Empty for processes not yet awarded.

contratosTotalUpstream.title: Contracts total upstream (detail records only)
contratosTotalUpstream.description: Upstream totalResults for this process's /contratos query -- compare against contratosCount to detect truncation (this actor fetches up to 1000 per process).

ofertas.title: Offers/bids (detail records only)
ofertas.description: Every offer submitted under this process, verbatim from DGCP's /ofertas endpoint -- includes bidder (razon_social/rpe), offer value (valor_oferta), and evaluation status.

articulos.title: Line items (detail records only)
articulos.description: Every requested line item under this process, verbatim from DGCP's /procesos/articulos endpoint -- includes UNSPSC classification, description, quantity, unit, and estimated pricing.

articulosTotalUpstream.title: Line items total upstream (detail records only)

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records -- rows missing a given column render blank.
